{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Australia won the 1930 Ashes series against England, winning two of the matches and losing one, with the other two tests drawn.","title":"Australian cricket team in England in 1930"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The Australian tourists were captained by Bill Woodfull, while the home side were led by Percy Chapman, who was dropped in favour of Bob Wyatt in the final Test.","title":"Australian cricket team in England in 1930"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"William Maldon \"Bill\" Woodfull OBE (22 August 1897 – 11 August 1965) was an Australian cricketer of the 1920s and 1930s.","title":"Bill Woodfull"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" He captained both Victoria and Australia, and was best known for his dignified and moral conduct during the tumultuous bodyline series in 1932–33 that almost saw the end of Anglo-Australian cricketing ties.","title":"Bill Woodfull"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Trained as a schoolteacher, Woodfull was known for his benevolent attitude towards his players, and his patience and defensive technique as an opening batsman.","title":"Bill Woodfull"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Woodfull was not a flamboyant player, but was known for his calm, unruffled style and his reliability in difficult situations.","title":"Bill Woodfull"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" His opening pairing with fellow Victorian Bill Ponsford for both his state and Australia remains one of the most successful in history.","title":"Bill Woodfull"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" While not known for his tactical skills, Woodfull was widely admired by his players and observers for his sportsmanship and ability to mould a successful and loyal team through the strength of his character.","title":"Bill Woodfull"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"Bill Woodfull opened pairing with what cricketer who died in April of 1991?"}
